decisions: Swap UI uses a compact sell/receive card and searchable token directory inspired by the user's Jupiter reference, while retaining SYMBaiEX forum colors, existing Dialog/Button primitives, responsive layout and explicit transaction review.

Trading terminal uses the user's Birdeye reference as a composition guide: a full-width connected analytical pane, persistent order column, compact asset/metric strips and a sortable sampled-market table. Retain forum navigation, Geist typography and magenta/teal identity, real source freshness and mounted protected receipts. Do not copy branding or invent trader rankings, order books or unsupported controls.

The condensed terminal keeps one header and one chart toolbar, a 380-420px desktop chart or 272px stacked chart, content-driven market height and compact data rows. Reduce chrome and duplicate price emphasis instead of financial readability; preserve 44px touch targets and always-reachable, mounted protected receipts.
